import re

    pat = re.compile(r"\[REWARD_LOG\] step=(\d+) reward=([\d.]+) prove_rate=([\d.]+) isr=([\d.]+)")
    steps = pat.findall(text)
    print(f"\n=== {label} ===")
    print(f"Total reward log lines: {len(steps)}")
    if not steps:
        return
    # extract last 100 + windowed
    rows = [(int(s), float(r), float(p), float(i)) for s,r,p,i in steps]
    last100 = rows[-100:]
    mean = lambda xs: sum(xs)/len(xs)
    print(f"Last100 prove_rate: {mean([r[2] for r in last100]):.4f}")
    print(f"Last100 isr:        {mean([r[3] for r in last100]):.4f}")
    print(f"Last100 reward:     {mean([r[1] for r in last100]):.4f}")
    # windowed 100s
    print("Windowed (per 100 steps):")
    for w in range(0, 500, 100):
        win = [r for r in rows if w < r[0] <= w+100]
        if win:
            print(f"  step {w+1:>3}-{w+100:>3}: pr={mean([r[2] for r in win]):.4f}  isr={mean([r[3] for r in win]):.4f}")
    # final loss from last training_state print
    runtime_m = re.search(r"'train_runtime': ([\d.]+)", text)
    if runtime_m:
        print(f"Train runtime: {float(runtime_m.group(1))/60:.1f} min")
    final_stats = re.search(r"Final reward stats: (\{[^}]+\})", text)
    if final_stats:
        print(f"Final stats: {final_stats.group(1)}")
    train_loss = re.search(r"'train_loss': ([\d.]+)", text)
    if train_loss:
        print(f"Train loss (overall): {train_loss.group(1)}")
